title: Bank & Payment Integrations for SYSPRO
shortDescription: Integrations connecting SYSPRO ERP to ABSA and RMB Fintegrate banking APIs and PayFast — covering payments, account verification and bank statement imports.
businessProblem: Businesses running SYSPRO needed to make payments, verify bank accounts and bring bank statements into their ERP without moving files and re-keying data between their bank and their finance system.
solution: Led and delivered integrations between SYSPRO and the ABSA and RMB Fintegrate banking APIs, and PayFast. The work covered payment integration, account verification and bank statement imports into SYSPRO, with secure API communication throughout. Technical and business stakeholders were guided through the architecture decisions, integration strategy, compliance requirements and rollout.
outcome: Connected the ERP directly to the bank, so payments, account verification and statement imports run through secure, controlled integrations instead of manual file handling.
capabilities: Payment integration with ABSA and RMB Fintegrate

title: Tax Authority E-Invoicing (ZRA & KRA)
shortDescription: REST API services that submit invoices to the Zambia Revenue Authority's Smart Invoice (VSDC) platform and integrate with the Kenya Revenue Authority's OSCU system.
businessProblem: Businesses operating in Zambia and Kenya must submit their invoices to the revenue authority's electronic invoicing system, in the required format and reliably. Getting this wrong is a compliance risk, and their existing processes did not cover it.
solution: Built and deployed REST API services that interface with the Zambia Revenue Authority's VSDC Smart Invoice platform for secure invoice submission, and delivered the compliance and reporting integration with the Kenya Revenue Authority's OSCU system. A CI/CD pipeline automatically tests every update, validates it against the authority's API specification and deploys it to staging and production with version control and rollback safety.
outcome: Automated, compliant invoice submission to two national revenue authorities. Deployment time dropped from hours to minutes, with consistent reliability across every environment.
capabilities: Secure invoice submission to ZRA Smart Invoice (VSDC)
KRA OSCU compliance and reporting integration
Validation against each authority's API specification
Staging and production releases with rollback

title: ERP Bank Reconciliation Suite
shortDescription: A finance application that helps teams import bank statements, match them to cashbook transactions and post reconciled results into ERP.
businessProblem: Finance teams were reconciling bank statements against ERP cashbook transactions through a slow, error-prone manual process. Statement import, matching rules and controlled posting back into the ERP were limited or missing.
solution: Built a substantial bank reconciliation suite available as both a desktop application and a web application. The solution imports bank statements with duplicate detection, supports manual and rule-based matching — including multi-transaction matching — can create related cashbook and AR transactions, and posts reconciled results into Syspro ERP with an auditable history.
outcome: Gave finance teams a structured way to import statements, reconcile transactions and post results into ERP, with live balance visibility during reconciliation and an auditable record of matching and posting activity.
capabilities: Bank statement import with duplicate detection
Posting of reconciled results into ERP
Creation of cashbook and AR transactions from unmatched bank items

title: ERP API Gateway & Production Reporting
shortDescription: An integration layer and reporting dashboard that lets modern applications and managers work with an existing ERP — without replacing it.
businessProblem: Modern applications and reporting tools struggled to use ERP business objects that were only available through older WCF/SOAP interfaces. Production and contract reporting also needed clearer visibility without slow manual extracts.
solution: Built a REST/JSON gateway that translates modern application requests into Syspro WCF business object calls and returns cleaned, structured JSON. The same solution includes a Blazor reporting dashboard for contract and production cost reporting, with Excel export and multi-company support, reading from ERP SQL databases where grid performance matters.
outcome: Extended the existing ERP environment so other applications could connect more easily, while giving management a clearer view of contract and production cost information that can be exported for further analysis.
capabilities: REST to ERP business object bridge
Structured JSON responses from ERP queries

title: Dispatch Stock Label Printing
shortDescription: A warehouse workstation tool that prints stock labels from ERP dispatch notes, with preview and reprint support.
businessProblem: After dispatch processing, warehouse staff needed accurate stock labels based on ERP dispatch note data. Preparing labels manually was slow, and reprinting previously printed labels was difficult.
solution: Delivered a Windows workstation application that retrieves dispatch note stock lines from Syspro, lets staff select lines and set per-line label quantities, provides print preview, and supports both automatic launch after dispatch processing and manual reprinting.
outcome: Enabled warehouse teams to print and reprint dispatch-related stock labels directly from ERP data on local workstations, reducing reliance on manual label preparation.

title: Supplier Banking Change Authorisation
shortDescription: An ERP workflow that introduces approval and audit control when supplier banking details change.
businessProblem: Changes to supplier banking details needed stronger control. Without a formal authorisation path and audit trail, high-risk master data updates could be made without clear review or notification.
solution: Implemented an ERP-embedded supplier banking change workflow. When banking details change, the system captures the request, records the old and new values, sets the change to pending approval and supports email notification as part of the controlled process.
outcome: Introduced a controlled authorisation path for supplier banking updates, with a recorded audit history of requested changes and clearer operational oversight.
capabilities: Audit trail of old and new values

title: Controlled Warehouse Inventory Transfer
shortDescription: An ERP-assisted inventory transfer process that enforces business-specific warehouse routing rules.
businessProblem: Inventory transfers between warehouses needed tighter control. Operators needed clearer guidance on which destination warehouses were allowed for a given stock item and source warehouse, rather than relying on informal knowledge.
solution: Added business-specific controls to the existing ERP inventory transfer process. SQL-backed warehouse route rules determine allowed destinations by stock code and source warehouse, guiding operators through controlled stock movement between locations.
outcome: Supported more controlled warehouse-to-warehouse transfers by enforcing configured routing rules instead of relying solely on manual knowledge of allowed movements.

title: Cloud Digital Signage Platform
shortDescription: An in-house, cloud-managed signage platform running 317 screens for brands like Nike, Jordan, Columbia and Vans across Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE.
businessProblem: Sun & Sand Sports (Gulf Marketing Group) was paying yearly licence fees for a third-party signage solution to manage in-store screens, and needed to deploy and schedule brand campaigns centrally across stores in several countries.
solution: Designed and developed SSS Digital, a signage platform for Windows and Android players driving displays and video walls. It is built around four stages — Displays (the connected devices), Media (video, images, web and RSS content), Layouts (groups of media) and Schedules (time-based campaigns) — so content can be deployed and scheduled remotely on every screen. The platform is managed by the in-house team.
outcome: Replaced the licensed solution, saving an estimated AED 634,000 a year. The platform runs 317 screens — digital displays, LED pelmets, large outdoor LEDs and video walls — for Nike, Jordan, Columbia, Vans, Converse, Sun & Sand Sports and Engine Health and Fitness.
capabilities: Remote content deployment to every store
Layouts combining video, images, web and RSS
Displays, LED pelmets, outdoor LEDs and video walls

title: Fitness HUB Retail Kiosks
shortDescription: Touch-screen kiosks that let Sun & Sand Sports customers browse, compare and buy fitness and cycling equipment — with no equipment taking up the shop floor.
businessProblem: Fitness and cycling equipment takes up a large share of retail floor space. The business needed to show its full range without dedicating store space to it, and free up the floor for a better commercial experience.
solution: Designed, developed and installed the SSS Fitness HUB: kiosk software that showcases the full fitness and cycling range and lets customers compare and purchase quickly, with zero equipment on the floor. After a pilot at Deira City Centre, versions were set up for Sports Market, Factory Outlet, the Dubai Hotel and Leisure Show and Pedaliere Dubai, where customers can also print product comparisons to take home.
outcome: 35 active Fitness HUBs across Qatar, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Bahrain, showcasing 454 products. Sales made through the Fitness HUB account for around 35% of total sales.
capabilities: Full product range without floor stock
Versions for multiple store formats and events
